# Hoop Intel HQ

> Link-in-bio page for @thehoopsintelhq on X: NBA, Knicks, HS, Euro and streetball basketball content, with links to three basketball sites.

## Sites

- [HoopsCampsFinder](https://hoopscampsfinder.com/): Browse youth basketball camps by location and compare your options.
- [PickupRunFinder](https://pickuprunfinder.com/): Browse pickup runs, open gyms and leagues by city. Check the source before you go.
- [HoopsGearRankings](https://hoopsgearrankings.com/): Training gear, home hoops and apps, compared by specs and price.

## Links

- [Home page](https://hoopintelhq.com/)
